text.title: EU AI Act Compliance — Procedure
text.summary: Eight-step procedure for applying `eu-ai-act-compliance`. Each step lists input artifact, action, output artifact. Decision gates live in content/06-decision-tree.xml.

step.name: scope-the-system
step.input: AI system inventory row + intended-use statement.
step.action: Extract: primary purpose, EU-deployment scope, user population, GPAI status.
step.output: Scoped system record with deployment_region + intended_use populated.

step.name: classify-risk-tier
step.action: Walk content/06-decision-tree.xml; assign one of prohibited / high-risk / limited-risk / minimal-risk / gpai / gpai-systemic.

step.name: cite-article-obligations
step.action: Look up the Article checklist for this tier; produce article_citations list and obligations table.
step.output: obligations[] array with article, obligation, owner, deadline.

step.name: gap-analyse-evidence
step.action: For every obligation check if evidence (doc, code, audit log) exists; record gaps with evidence_missing.

step.name: generate-evidence
step.input: gaps[] + eval dataset with sensitive-attribute columns + model class.
step.action: Close the documentary gaps: draft the model card and data sheet per Article 11; run a Fairlearn / AIF360 bias report over the eval set; produce explainability artefacts matched to the model class — for a black-box transformer, behavioural evaluation with the limitation stated, not SHAP output presented as interpretability. For limited-risk, produce the Article 50 disclosure copy and any required watermarking instead.
step.output: Model card + data sheet + bias report (JSON) + explainability section, or Article 50 disclosure copy.
step.decision-gate: If the bias check needs personal data, run the DPIA first and pseudonymise — GDPR applies in parallel (r12-gdpr-parallel-track).

step.name: document-and-store
step.action: Fill conformity-self-assessment.md or technical-doc-article11.md; commit to compliance repo.

step.name: legal-review-handoff
step.action: Reviewer subagent cross-checks every article citation against the official Act text and flags anything unverifiable; hand grey-zone classifications to legal counsel; then HALT for human sign-off.
step.output: Reviewer report + reviewer_signoff recorded in the conformance record and the commit message.
step.decision-gate: Any flagged citation returns to step 5 with the flags. Block until the named human signs; do not proceed on a timeout.

step.name: register-and-monitor
step.action: Register a high-risk system in the EU AI database per Article 49; configure post-market monitoring per Article 72; wire the CI gate that re-triggers step 2 on any substantial modification.
step.output: EU database registration id + monitoring dashboard + CI re-classification gate.
